items.html: Thus this phase is the first Yud of HaVaYaH, which includes the whole expansion of the Mochin, and is called Hochma. It is the Mem of Tzelem, and it is air, and it is the first six Sefirot of the third Tevuna, and it is called Tzelem, because the two letters Tzadi-Lamed are found in it, their root included here in the Mem.
